Jay Rodriguez - Catch The Hands Hand Fig.overview: B-Team competitor Jay Rodriguez on hand fighting for takedowns, four parts. Part 1 covers the concepts of starting the hand fight (feints and fakes). Part 2 covers ties and trips (the over tie, the Russian trip). Part 3 covers snaps and snap downs. Part 4 is rolling with commentary.
Jay Rodriguez - Catch The Hands Hand Fig.for: No-gi grapplers who want to win the hand fight before shooting.
key: Over tie and Russian tie trips

Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.overview: Bernardo Faria's bottom game for older grapplers, five volumes. Volume 1 explains why closed and half guard suit older players. Volume 2 covers getting from half guard to closed guard (including from flat half). Volume 3 covers closed guard attacks (an efficient omoplata and others). Volume 4 covers going from closed guard back to half guard when they open it. Volume 5 covers the safest ways to pull half guard and jump to closed guard.
Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.for: Older or less athletic gi players who want a safe, effective bottom game.
key: Why closed and half guard for older grapplers
